dlqTransitionEvidence.interpretation: Three main-queue DeleteMessage outcomes of type 'dlq' and three matching DLQ writes are observable, together with a main-queue backlog 1->0 and DLQ 2->3 delta. This demonstrates the automatic retry->DLQ transition path is active under the unchanged max_retries=3 / retry_delay=60 policy.
dlqTransitionEvidence.limitation: Cloudflare exposes no read-only message-body peek for a push-consumer queue: GET .../messages returns HTTP 405, /messages/preview returns 10405 'Method not allowed for this authentication scheme', and POST .../messages/pull returns 405 'messages cannot be pulled unless http_pull mode is enabled'. Therefore the injected probe (key m8:invalid:gate-probe) cannot be tied by body to a specific DLQ write from the API. It is not purged or deleted to preserve that evidence.

diagnosis: The 14 missing projection rows had post-Gate2 p3.article.v1 null-role versions with no runtime legacy freshness classification.
Their existing draft P3 versions also lacked summary_json, so classifying and directly publishing the stale version was not eligible.

The safe repair captures the current legacy article into a new immutable P3 version, classifies that inserted legacy version current using the original legacy_same_version semantics, and publishes through article_publication_transition_p3 without weakening ARTICLE_P3_FRESHNESS_UNKNOWN.
